title: CliArgument
description: One argument of a command or a verb. An argument is a FIELD of what declares it, not a thing with its own identity — which is where the declaration tree stops: a directory per flag would be fragmentation rather than structure.

name.description: The flag as typed (--session) or the positional's name. A flag never names a value of an axis its command already enumerates (G21).

type.description: The value metavar — <uuid8>, claude|gemini — and empty for a boolean flag, which is how a flag is told from an option.

cardinality.description: Empty is optional; `1` is exactly one, required; `N/<class>` is N over the set quotient by <class>, the mutually-exclusive args sharing that class being one equivalence class.

help.description: The wording argparse shows for this argument; the target declares the structure, this the words.
